name: SE-600-24
description: High-power 600W enclosed power supply from MeanWell's SE series. The largest commonly-used MeanWell PSU in 3D printing. Features forced-air cooling with a significantly larger form factor than the LRS series. Used in large-format printers like the Ender 5 Plus and custom builds with large DC heated beds requiring substantial current delivery.
typicalUseCases: Large-format 3D printers with DC heated beds
Custom builds with 300mm+ heated beds on DC power
